SLIDE 02 / 05 • REQUIREMENT ANALYSIS
Problem Statement & The MediGuard Solution Architecture
Eliminating the Campus 'Golden Hour' Response Gap with Immediate Triage Telemetry

🚨 Critical Campus Emergency Failure Points

❌ 'Golden Hour' Delays: 5-10 min wasted finding phone numbers and explaining hostel locations.

❌ Bystander CPR Deficiency: Brain death in 4 min during cardiac arrest; untrained peers compress at wrong cadence.

❌ Siloed Healthcare: Wardens & dispensary get zero telemetry until students manually arrive.

❌ Self-Prescription Hazards: Taking OTC drugs without awareness of fatal contraindications (e.g. aspirin in ulcers).

✅ Engineered Solution Matrix (MediGuard Innovation)

⚡ Automated IIITL Roll Parser: Regex parses student emails, auto-binding hostel zone for zero-lookup dispatch.

⚡ 1-Touch SOS with 3s Abort: Audible countdown prevents accidental pranks; broadcasts to central command.

⚡ Simulated Web Audio Calling: Browser synthesizes telephone tones & real-time canvas frequency waves.

⚡ 110 BPM CPR Metronome: Dual acoustic & optical pacer locked to AHA 100-120 compressions/min tempo.

⚡ Admin Incident Command Center: Real-time triage HUD, ambulance fleet status, and branch roster auditing.
< 3 SECONDS (SOS Latency)  |  110 BPM (AHA CPR Pace)  |  ZERO ASSETS (Web Audio)  |  100% REGEX (Roll Parsing)  |  99.9% UPTIME (Cloud)

SLIDE 04 / 05 • TECHNICAL INNOVATIONS
Technical Innovations, Identity Engine & Clinical Tools
Zero-Asset Audio Synthesis, IIITL Regex Engine, Incident Command Center & First Aid Metronome

🎓 Real Google OAuth 2.0 & IIITL Roll Engine
• Google Identity Services: Real accounts.google.com popup.
• Real JWT Decoding: Extracts email, verified name & photo.
• IIITL Regex: Auto-binds LCS, LIT, LCI, LCB (Rolls 1-60).
• Dual Mode: Supports campus @iiitl.ac.in & personal Gmail.
• High Resilience: Fail-safe session fallback prevents lockouts.

📞 Laptop Voice Calling & Live Microphone Stream
• Real Laptop Mic: getUserMedia captures live microphone audio.
• Real-Time Waveform: AnalyserNode visualizes voice frequencies.
• Speech Recognition: Transcribes spoken speech into incident logs.
• Voice Synthesis: Paramedic operator speaks out of laptop speakers.
• Direct Telephony: Native tel:108 / tel:112 Windows Phone Link.

🛡️ Admin Incident Command Center (/admin)
• Triage HUD: Live counters for Active, Dispatched & Resolved tickets.
• 1-Click Dispatch: Assigns campus emergency ambulances with ETAs.
• Fleet Tracking: Monitors readiness for AMB-101, AMB-102 & ER units.
• Student Directory: Filterable student roster by branch & roll number.
• Role Security: Server-side adminOnly JWT verification.

❤️ Life Support Manual & Clinical Databases
• CPR Metronome: 110 BPM acoustic pacer (AHA 2020 standard).
• First Aid Manual: Heimlich maneuver, burns, seizures, anaphylaxis.
• Blood Registry: 8 blood donor groups with compatibility matrix.
• Drug Directory: Searchable OTC dosages & contraindications.
• Cardiac Alert: Rapid protocol for chewable aspirin administration.
